name: trimesh-canonical-ots
instr:
The repository at `/workdir` is trimesh, a Python library for loading, processing and exporting triangular meshes
and 2D/3D vector paths: the `Trimesh` mesh class and its geometry helpers (bounds, convex hulls, inertia, repair,
sampling, plane intersections, subdivision, primitives and creation functions, transformations, units, caching), the
`Path2D`/`Path3D` vector path classes with their entities, polygons and DXF/SVG exchange, and the mesh importers and
exporters (STL, OBJ, PLY, OFF, GLTF/GLB, 3MF, COLLADA, XAML, 3DXML, XYZ, URDF).

Fix all implementation drift from the documentation in this repository.
Everything in scope is the trimesh core modules trimesh/base.py, trimesh/util.py, trimesh/grouping.py, trimesh/units.py, trimesh/transformations.py, trimesh/geometry.py, trimesh/triangles.py, trimesh/bounds.py, trimesh/creation.py, trimesh/primitives.py, trimesh/caching.py, trimesh/convex.py, trimesh/inertia.py, trimesh/repair.py, trimesh/points.py, trimesh/intersections.py, trimesh/remesh.py, trimesh/sample.py, trimesh/nsphere.py, trimesh/comparison.py and trimesh/interval.py, the whole vector path package trimesh/path/, and the whole mesh exchange package trimesh/exchange/ except trimesh/exchange/binvox.py and trimesh/exchange/cascade.py, together with the documentation pages README.md and docs/content/formats.md and the module, class and function docstrings of the in-scope modules.

Where the code and the documentation disagree about runtime behavior, the documentation
